name: reordered and revised storage policy
before: The collector must retain audit records for 90 days.
NET-1: The collector shall encrypt telemetry.
OPS-4: The collector may retry uploads during maintenance.
after: OPS-4: The collector must retry uploads only if maintenance is scheduled.
NET-1: The collector shall encrypt telemetry.
The collector must keep audit logs for 180 days.

name: one-to-many ambiguous change
before: The gateway must retain event logs for 30 days.
after: The gateway must retain event logs for 60 days.
The gateway must retain event logs for 90 days.

name: similar wording but distinct identifiers
before: SEC-1: The gateway must encrypt messages in transit.
after: SEC-2: The gateway must encrypt messages at rest.

name: different numbers in similar requirements
before: The inlet valve must close within 10 seconds.
The outlet valve must close within 15 seconds.
after: The outlet valve must close within 20 seconds.
The inlet valve must close within 8 seconds.

name: German condition change
before: NET-4: Das Gateway darf erneut senden, wenn der Puffer voll ist.
after: NET-4: Das Gateway muss erneut senden, nur wenn der Puffer voll ist.

name: Russian minimum runtime

after: PWR-1: Шлюз должен работать от батареи не менее 45 минут.

name: requirement renumbered with a stable identifier elsewhere

after: NET-2: The gateway must encrypt outbound traffic.
